sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Huntsman Path - Justice is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Good to see you, kid. Have you ever tracked prey during a hunt? When all this chaos started in Tarkov, I've seen all kinds of things. Those who were supposed to uphold the law became even worse than the criminals they were meant to stop. Some of them didn't even bother changing out of their uniforms, can you believe that? I have my own reasons for wanting them gone. Deal with the remaining members of Reshala's crew. They'll be wearing police uniforms, so you won't have any trouble recognizing them. And bring me one of their armor vests as a trophy."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Eliminate 3 Reshala's guards
- Hand over one of Reshala's guards' armor vest

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- Jaeger Rep +0.1
- 80,000 Roubles
  - 84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 2× Corrugated hose
"You did a good thing. One more piece of filth has been removed from this world. Here, this is from both me and the Mechanic."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
In this quest you have to kill 3 of Reshala's followers and hand over 1 of their found in raid armors. You can hand over any of the following:
- 6B43 Zabralo-Sh body armor (EMR)
- BNTI Gzhel-K body armor
- BNTI Zhuk body armor (EMR)
- BNTI Zhuk body armor (EMR)
- FORT Defender-2 body armor
- FORT Redut-M body armor
- NPP KlASS Korund-VM body armor (Black)
